subject: Partner SI joint solution workshop - architecture review
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@si-inc.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Joint solution workshop — proposed dates

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for connecting at the partner summit. We'd like to kick off a joint solution workshop with Redwood and the SI team to go through an architecture-level integration review and a short implementation plan. Proposed outcomes: alignment on integration touchpoints, a draft mutual action plan, and next-step owners.

Proposed dates (PST):
- Mon, May 17 — 10:00–11:30 AM
- Tue, May 18 — 2:00–3:30 PM

Attendees from our side: Alex Chen (SI lead), Priya Singh (marketplace lead), Ryan Patel (eng manager). Estimated 60–90 minutes. Could you confirm availability and who from Redwood should join? Happy to take a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Partnerships, SaaS Integrations Inc.
alex.chen@si-inc.com

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint solution workshop — proposed dates

Hi Alex,

Great to hear — we should absolutely do this. Thanks for the proposed slots. Our initial availability is limited earlier in the week, but we can make time on:

- Wed, May 19 — 10:00–11:30 AM PT
- Thu, May 20 — 9:00–10:30 AM PT

I’m looping in Jonas (solutions engineering) and Vanessa (partnerships) who will co-drive the session with me. Plan for a 75-minute deep dive: 30 minutes architecture/runtime review, 25 minutes integration touchpoints and API/operational requirements, 20 minutes next steps + MAP.

Attaching a draft agenda for visibility: redwood_workshop_agenda_v1.docx (see bullets inside). If May 19 works for you, we’ll send an invite and attach the architecture deck.

Thanks,

Head of Strategic Partnerships

marissa@redwood.com
